Inverness Counsel Llc decreased its stake in Walt Disney Co (DIS) by 14.43% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Inverness Counsel Llc sold 51,482 shares as the company’s stock declined 6.93% with the market. The institutional investor held 305,211 shares of the television services company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $30.66 million, down from 356,693 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Inverness Counsel Llc who had been investing in Walt Disney Co for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $148.10B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.11% or $0.11 during the last trading session, reaching $99.36. About 6.85 million shares traded. The Walt Disney Company (NYSE:DIS) has declined 4.73% since June 2, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 17.30% the S&P500.
Inverness Counsel Llc, which manages about $2.49B and $1.66 billion US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 49,273 shares to 217,412 shares, valued at $36.48M in 2018Q1, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Roper Technologies (NYSE:ROP) by 49,270 shares in the quarter, for a total of 767,863 shares, and has risen its stake in Jp Morgan Chase (NYSE:JPM).
Analysts await The Walt Disney Company (NYSE:DIS) to report earnings on August, 14. They expect $1.98 earnings per share, up 25.32 % or $0.40 from last year’s $1.58 per share. DIS’s profit will be $2.95B for 12.55 P/E if the $1.98 EPS becomes a reality. After $1.84 actual earnings per share reported by The Walt Disney Company for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts 7.61 % EPS growth.
